faqs.question: What is the application fee for BS at VVISM Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: The VVISM BS application process is incomplete without submitting a non-refundable application fee along with the application form and the required documents. The application fee for BS at the institute is INR 600. Candidates applying online can pay this fee through the secure payment gateway on the institute's official website. faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to BBA at Vishwa Vishwani Institute of Systems and Management?
faqs.answer: BBA admission at Vishwa Vishwani Institute of Systems and Management (VVISM) are entrance-based. The university conducts Online Aptitude Test to shortlist applicants. Shortlisted applicants are required to appear for a Personal Interview (PI). Applicants are required to score at least 50% on the aptitude test and the personal interview to secure a seat for BBA at VVISM. They must also satisfy the preset eligibility criteria. The institute gives preference to those who have a valid exam score in JEE Mains/ NEET/ CLAT/ IPM/ TSEAMCET/ APEAPCET/ MHCET/ UGAT/ SAT or any equivalent entrance exams conducted by the respective State Government or Union Territory (UT). Hence, one can not take direct admission at VVISM for BBA.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Great learning experience with strong faculty and excellent facilities.

review_content.Placements: Over 90 percent of students from the PGDM batch (2024-2026) secured internships. Internships are offered at companies like Deloitte, Berkadia, Metri4Analytics, Aspire Consultation, TIMES, Crystal Crops, High-field Organics, KIMS Hospital, Yashoda Hospital, and others.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms equipped with ICT (multimedia), smart boards, Wi-Fi/LAN, PA system, and good ventilation & lighting. Internet access is available across most of the campus. English Communication Lab for language and soft-skills learning. The LRC has a Borrowing Section, Reference Section, and a Journal Section. Many management textbooks, domain-specific/reference books, and journals.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, it's a good college for pursuing an MBA.

review_content.Placements: The placement record of our institute is good. Many students receive placement offers from our institute. The return on investment is satisfactory. Top recruiting companies like ICICI, Airtel, ITC, and more hire students. The average package offered is between 5.4 to 6 LPA. Considering the fees, this college provides good placement opportunities.
review_content.Infrastructure: Campus area of our institute is very beautiful. All the facilities are available here, the labs are well-equipped with many computers, and there are great classrooms and a library with a variety of books. Free Wi-Fi is not provided by the college on the campus. Overall, our institute provides good infrastructure.

reviews_list.batch_info: BS in Computer Science (AI and ML) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: The infrastructure is one of the best in Hyderabad, providing a clean and safe environment.

review_content.Placements: Salesman placements only. Currently, not even a handful of students have landed jobs. They got placed in their final semester as data analysts. As for a few others, they ended up in salesman-type jobs, which seem completely useless for a career. If you're considering joining this, it’s better to look for a placement on your own.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is excellent, but there are no hostel facilities available. Classrooms and corridors are neat and clean, and the libraries and three labs are just okay. The whole college is equipped with numerous cameras that provide students with security and safety.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Gain practical experience with good placements.

review_content.Placements: Currently, I am pursuing PGDM. Around 90% of students got placed. The highest package is 10 LPA. The average package is 7 LPA to 8 LPA, and the lowest is around 4.5 LPA. Top most recruiting companies are Deloitte, Times, etc. 100% of students got internships at companies like Deloitte, Times, Magnik India, Then Publications, Prime Raise, and so on. Mainly offered roles are sales manager, recruiting manager, branch manager, store manager, accounts manager, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure wise its an excellent college that has a degree + MBA + PGDM with separate blocks including facilities like Wi-Fi, digital classrooms, a big playground, bus facility around Hyderabad, and many more. Our college tied up with Stanza to provide a hostel for students.

reviews_list.batch_info: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Good placement and internship opportunities are provided.

review_content.Placements: The placement is done according to student standards, and the institute tries to provide each a fair opportunity. The highest package is 8 LPA, and the lowest package is 4 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Axis Securities, Deloitte, ITC, and others. The roles offered include Store Manager and others.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has labs, Wi-Fi, and classrooms with advanced technology. The college provides online facilities as well. There is a very big library, and all the study material is provided by the college itself. There is no college hostel, but the college is tied up with Stanza Living, and if you want, you can find other accommodations.

paragraphs: VVISM Hyderabad admission processincludes filling an online application form, passing the selection rounds and fee payment. Check the detailed steps related to VVISM Hyderabad admission:
Application Process

Candidates can participate in the VVISM admission process by filling an application form either in online or offline modes. Candidates can either visit the official website or the admission office of the institute for the application form.
Selection Rounds

Admission to all the courses is merit or entrance-based. For UG courses, students are given admission based on their merit in the last qualifying exam. Selected candidates are called for a PI round. Admission to the PG course is based on CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT, GMAT or ATMA scores, then group discussion and personal interview round.
Merit List & Admission Confirmation
The institute accepts entrance exam scores, GDPI rounds, experience and academic performance of the candidates for PGDM admission.
Selected candidates have to pay theVVSIM Hyderabad feeto confirm their seat in the institute.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for BBA at VVISM Hyderabad?

Aspirants must hold the documents proving their eligibility for verification at the time of admission.

Candidates must complete Class 12 or intermediate from any state or central board with at least 50% aggregate to apply for VVSIM Hyderabad BBA programme.

faqs.question: Can I get admission at VVISM Hyderabad without any entrance exam?
faqs.answer: The answer to this question depends on the course opted by the candidate. Aspirants applying for PGDM have to pass any of the accepted entrance exams for admission. The institute considers CAT, XAT, CMAT, ATMA, GMAT scores for PGDM admission. However, aspirants applying for UG courses can get admission without entrance exams cores. Such candidates are selected based on their merit in the last qualifying exam.

faqs.question: How to get admission to VVISM Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: VVSIM Hyderabad admissions are both merit and entrance-based. The institute considers entrance exams such as CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT, GMAT or ATMA for PGDM admission. Selected candidates are further called for a group discussion and personal interview round for admission.The selection for UG courses is based on merit of the aspirants in the last qualifying exam. Candidates with a score in an entrance exam can also apply for UG programmes. Shortlisted aspirants have to further pass a personal interview for final admission.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for BS admission at VVISM Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: As of now, VVISM Hyderabad has not specified the deadline to apply for BS admission. The institute is expected to release the last date to apply on its official wesbite. Usually, the application and admission process is conducted betweenJanuary and May, every year. The classes for the programme typically commence in the first week of July each year.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for PGDM admission at VVISM Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: The VVISM Hyderabad PGDM application process is incomplete without submitting the specified application fee along with the required documents. The application fee for the PGDM at the institute is INR 1,200. It is non-refundable. Candidates applying online can pay this fee through the secure payment gateway on the institute's official website. Candidates applying in offline mode can pay the fee through Cash or any other accepted medium (Card, UPI, etc.).

placement_data.title: Vishwa Vishwani Institute of Systems and Management Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The placement process at Vishwa Vishwani Institute of Systems and Management includes a comprehensive pre-placement training and skill development program for the students. The final placements at Vishwa Vishwani Institute of Systems and Management are a result of very systematic interaction with the industry and continuous career counselling of the students. The Internship Programme at VVISM provides students with vital hands-on experience, bridging the gap between academic theory and real-world business operations.

The placements have been completed at Vishwa Vishwani Institute of Systems and Management for the batch passing out in 2025. As per the latest report, the highest and average package offered so far during VVISM placements 2025 stood at INR 10 LPA and INR 6 LPA, respectively . The institute recorded 95% placements till now for the Class of 2025. Further, the institute witnessed the participation of 54 recruiters in 2025 who placed students in various new-age job roles.

Earlier, the institute concluded the placements for the Class of 2024 with a 91% placement rate . The highest and average package offered during VVISM placements in 2024 was INR 10 LPA and INR 6 LPA, respectively . The top recruiters of Vishwa Vishwani Institute of Systems and Management in 2024 and 2025 included Home First, BMW, Bandhan Bank, Tech Mahindra, Accenture, ITC, S&P Global, Bandhan Bank, Berkadia , etc.

reviews.review_heading: Great learning experience with strong faculty and excellent facilities.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms equipped with ICT (multimedia), smart boards, Wi-Fi/LAN, PA system, and good ventilation & lighting. Internet access is available across most of the campus. English Communication Lab for language and soft-skills learning. The LRC has a Borrowing Section, Reference Section, and a Journal Section. Many management textbooks, domain-specific/reference books, and journals.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it's a good college for pursuing an MBA.
reviews.review_text: Campus area of our institute is very beautiful. All the facilities are available here, the labs are well-equipped with many computers, and there are great classrooms and a library with a variety of books. Free Wi-Fi is not provided by the college on the campus. Overall, our institute provides good infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is one of the best in Hyderabad, providing a clean and safe environment.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent, but there are no hostel facilities available. Classrooms and corridors are neat and clean, and the libraries and three labs are just okay. The whole college is equipped with numerous cameras that provide students with security and safety.

reviews.review_heading: Gain practical experience with good placements.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure wise its an excellent college that has a degree + MBA + PGDM with separate blocks including facilities like Wi-Fi, digital classrooms, a big playground, bus facility around Hyderabad, and many more. Our college tied up with Stanza to provide a hostel for students.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement and internship opportunities are provided.
reviews.review_text: The college has labs, Wi-Fi, and classrooms with advanced technology. The college provides online facilities as well. There is a very big library, and all the study material is provided by the college itself. There is no college hostel, but the college is tied up with Stanza Living, and if you want, you can find other accommodations.

reviews.review_heading: It is a college that transforms students into professionals.
reviews.review_text: Every classroom has air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and SMART boards to support modern learning. The college also has a large library with a wide range of books that are very helpful for our studies and academic growth. This makes the classroom engaging, allowing both students and teachers to use digital tools and upgrade their knowledge. The library with various books enables students to explore new things.

reviews.review_heading: Vishwa Vishwani Institute of Systems and Management is the best institute for career guidance.
reviews.review_text: The college provides good infrastructure such as digital boards, AC classrooms with Wi-Fi facilities, computer labs, etc. The college provides a hostel (stanza) for students coming from different states and regions, a canteen with good hygiene and sports (such as Cricket, Badminton, Volleyball, chess, carrom, etc. ). Followed by an annual sports meet (celebration sports day once in a year where the best performers are awarded).

reviews.review_heading: It has good faculty, really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The campus has everything we need for a smooth learning experience. Facilities like Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and computer labs make everyday study easy. The library is a quiet spot with plenty of useful books.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of my professional career development.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our PGDM course are classrooms with Wi-Fi and air-conditioned facilities. It has a huge library with various different kinds of books, daily magazines, and newspapers. Students are offered daily newspapers for real-world experience and the current situation of the world. There are provisions for medical facilities in case of any emergency. There are sports for physical and mental health balance.

reviews.review_heading: It is absolutely privileged to be a part of this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is great. It has centralized AC classrooms, labs, and Wi-Fi enabled. It is really calm on the campus and surrounded by nature. Facilities are really good. The canteen is also good.

review_summary.college_name: Guru Ramdas Khalsa Institute of Science and Technology (GRKIST) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with its faculty members that is why I join this college.

content.Placements: In this college, there are 120 students. The students are giving their 100% effort. As for as recruiting companies are concerned near about 50%, and the top recruiting companies are Cipla, Dr. Reddy's, Zyddus, Cadila, etc.
content.Infrastructure: This college has ultimate level for pursuing any degree. If I will look for degree that is pharmacy practicals plays a vast role, for that this college carries every facility. Our college is far from city.
content.Faculty: Teachers are knowledgeable and helpful. As I am belonging from Kashmir which is far from this college but when first visit I visualised the whole scenario I decided to pursue pharmacy from this college. As for as the studies are concerned, it has ultimate level with practicals also.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The college is good for learning and skills development.

content.Placements: Students are getting jobs with average packages in our course. Many pharmacy companies like Cipla, Dr. Reddy's, etc., visit our college for placements, and these are one of the top 10 pharma companies in India. Students also qualify in competitive exams like GPAT and NIPER.
content.Infrastructure: Labs are above average. I enjoy it very much. It also has a canteen, but the canteen is not that good as it is very far from the city. We have to come by bus by traveling 1 hour to reach college.
content.Faculty: Teachers are very good in our college. The learning process is quite entertaining because of practical works as our course is related to chemistry. Teachers are well-educated and skilled. They help us to get knowledge. All things are average. Exams are conducted strictly, and their checking is also strict. Exams are conducted very often, and it also took online recently through a zoom meeting.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2013
individual_reviews.title: GRKIST is a well-established college for a good education. Opt this college for your career.

content.Placements: Almost 40% of the students were placed in companies like TCS, Mahindra, Wipro, Mind Tree and many more. The salary package offered is ranged from 2 LPA to 5 LPA. About 30-40% of the students got internships. We had nice faculty members who are friendly. They are really helpful to us, and they never give up.
content.Infrastructure: Labs here were good. There are nice classrooms along with a good environment. There is a huge ground for games and fiction. We also have indoor games, like table tennis, chase, etc. We had good and friendly faculty members. They are really helpful and have teaching ability.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: College provides good facilities for students.

content.Placements: Above 65% of students got placements in this course and the salary offered is good. Top recruiting companies like Tata Consultancy Services, KVCH, HCL, etc., visited the campus. And this course compulsory study coding languages like Java, c, c+, HTML, PHP, Net, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Our department infrastructure is very good and provides good facilities like Wi-Fi, lab, huge classrooms, library, sports and other activities are provided. Our hostel is very good, and provides mess facilities also, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely dissatisfied because of faculty.

content.Placements: Only 20% of the students were placed in our course. The highest average salary offered ranges from Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 30,000 per month. Only a few companies like TCS, Mahindra, etc., are recruiting companies. Only 10% of students got the internship from our course in companies like Maruti, Mahindra etc.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities of our college are very poor. Infrastructure is good. But lab facility is very disappointing because the instruments are very old and bad in condition. Moreover, it is not working properly, and even some instruments are damaged from years. In the library, books are not available according to subjects, and most of the books are a very old version. In the library, books are never updated according to requirement and according to the new syllabus. The quality of the food is very bad, and most of the time, food is not available in the canteen and hostel facility also disappointed for all the students.

review_summary.college_name: Sangam University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It has brilliant faculty members and a fantastic campus.

content.Placements: 89% of students get placed every year. The lowest package is 4 LPA, and the highest package is 19 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Acmegrade and Wipro. Top roles offered in the course are marketing, salesperson, finance, human resources, and other management jobs.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are well-organised and classrooms are digital, including a digital board, CCTV cameras, and a big library. The infrastructure is good for students as well as faculty members. Facilities available in the hostel are a mess, water coolers, etc.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Review of Sangam University.

content.Placements: The percentage of students placed in this course was very good. The highest package offered to a student was 15 LPA, and the lowest was 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies visited this college, and the percentage of students who got internships in this course was more than 20%.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available in this course were very good. Wi-Fi and classrooms were present, and the library was also available. The quality of food provided in this course was very tasty. Medical facilities were available. Sports and games were also present in the college.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Sangam University College review.

content.Placements: Students who scored around 50-60% and above, and the package for each student may be around 5 LPA - 15 LPA depending on their course. They had many connections with plenty of recruiting companies in each course. I am in the textile and fashion design course, so it had very vast roles in its field.
content.Infrastructure: The college had the best infrastructure compared to the other colleges in the city. Wi-Fi was available all around the campus. Our classrooms were very clean. The library had good books. We had clean washrooms. The hostel did not provide good things. The food was the worst. Sports were good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied with the college environment, no fun or extracurricular activities.

The positions mainly provided are not satisfying the BBA passed out and are placed as trainees and something like that but here the positions which are offered are like tele caller, cashier, etc.

The mess and canteen are still good and if I talk about medical facilities I don't know much about it but still got everything I needed in times of emergency. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Placements are not that good but college life is great.

content.Placements: I am currently in B.Tech CSE 6th semester. Almost 90% of total students are placed but don't ask for the salary, it's just only 1 or 2 students get a good salary, other than those all get a very minimum salary like 2 LPA. Top recruiter is Sangam India as they are in the same industry as university. It is compulsory for all students to grab an internship in their 8th semester. Top roles offered are data entry and software engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is not that good. University has gym, mess, canteen but lacks what's inside those. Some of the rooms are well-furnished and maintained for special events and labs for tech field students are developed. Also, medical facilities are very less. Quality of food in canteen is decent, sometimes it's good and sometimes not that good. Sports facilities are not provided at all here.

hostel.description: Separate hostels for boys and girls carefully designed and planned with 24/7 security. The students can choose single, double or triple occupancy including three nutritiously balanced vegetarians (breakfast, lunch, dinner) and Hi-tea in the evenings. Hostels are well equipped with modern kitchens serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. The stay at our campus provides a treasure of experience by developing alliance and social responsibility.

library.description: The library has a reading room equipped with over 115 national and international journals, magazines, periodicals and newspapers to fulfill and supplement the academic needs of the students. Learning aids like educational charts, CD’s, book bank facility and reprographic services are also available. Library equipped with Lib-Sys software and barcoding system. To augment students’ learning, the university has a well-stocked digitized Library. reviews.review_heading: It has brilliant faculty members and a fantastic campus.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are well-organised and classrooms are digital, including a digital board, CCTV cameras, and a big library. The infrastructure is good for students as well as faculty members. Facilities available in the hostel are a mess, water coolers, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sangam University.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in this course were very good. Wi-Fi and classrooms were present, and the library was also available. The quality of food provided in this course was very tasty. Medical facilities were available. Sports and games were also present in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Sangam University College review.
reviews.review_text: The college had the best infrastructure compared to the other colleges in the city. Wi-Fi was available all around the campus. Our classrooms were very clean. The library had good books. We had clean washrooms. The hostel did not provide good things. The food was the worst. Sports were good.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the college environment, no fun or extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text: If we talk about facilities, hostel, and sports facilities are not that good. The mess and canteen are still good and if I talk about medical facilities I don't know much about it but still got everything I needed in times of emergency. Hostel buildings are old and moldy and there is no Wi-Fi facility available and also for sports facility they only have cricket and basketball and they don't have any indoor games as such.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are not that good but college life is great.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not that good. University has gym, mess, canteen but lacks what's inside those. Some of the rooms are well-furnished and maintained for special events and labs for tech field students are developed. Also, medical facilities are very less. Quality of food in canteen is decent, sometimes it's good and sometimes not that good. Sports facilities are not provided at all here.

reviews.review_heading: My experience with Sangam University has been absolutely wonderful!
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are very good here, and the infrastructure is of good quality to give proper education for students. All the rooms in the hostel are in good condition, and the quality of food provided in the mess is also good. The hostel facilities are good and include Wi-Fi, single rooms, and double bedrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Building not of brick but of memories.
reviews.review_text: Everything was good about the course. I do not know much about the hostel, but I visited the hostel a few times. The hostel was good with nice facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Sangam university review of Shiksha.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are available in my course. The infrastructure of the college is superb, and classrooms and the library are available, but Wi-Fi is not provided. The food in the college canteen is not tasty. Medical facilities are not available in this course. Sports and games are always happening in my college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the Sangam university.
reviews.review_text: All the basic and good facilities are provided in the my course . Wi-Fi and labs, as well as classrooms, are provided to all students in the college. The food quality of the canteen is so good. Medical facilities are also available. Sports and games are very good.

reviews.review_heading: Good facilities and placements are available.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent, and various facilities are available. Separate departments are provided, and classrooms are well cleaned. Wi-Fi and labs are available, and the food quality is acceptable. The mess is very hygienic, and sports and games are offered. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: According to the budget, the campus is good, the staff has a good nature, and placements are average
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good with fully Wi-Fi-enabled campus. There is good competition in sports and opportunities; personally, I played cricket for the university. The food tastes better, and the quality is good. The medical facility could be better, and the canteen is not good; the service is average.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sangam University.
reviews.review_text: The college offers excellent facilities, and the infrastructure is impressive. Both Wi-Fi and a well-equipped library are available. While the food in the canteen is not the tastiest, it is healthy. Medical and sports facilities are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: Good college but poor facilities are available.
reviews.review_text: Excellent infrastructure is available, but facilities are very poor; they provide food and Wi-Fi of poor quality, classrooms are not cleaned, and separate departments are available. A medical kit is available in college. Sports and games are conducted every semester.

reviews.review_heading: Sangam University review.
reviews.review_text: Superb facilities and infrastructure are provided in my course. Wi-Fi, classrooms, library — all facilities are available. The food quality in the college canteen is bad, not tasty. Medical facilities and services are provided to the students. Sports and games facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Review is really good for this college.
reviews.review_text: There is a Wi-Fi along with the labs and classrooms being good. Infrastructure is really good compared to the other in budget Universities. Also I tried the hostel but it is also good. There are some events which take place every year and there is a specific sports room do which you need permission to access.

review_summary.college_name: MIT Group of Institutes (Mahakal), Ujjain Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I am disappointed by faculty members and bus problems. One can take admission just for.

content.Placements: There are no placements for graduation students, no internship opportunities, and no classes. The highest package is 9 LPA. Companies like ICICI and many others recruit. This year, internships were offered only to final-year and second-year students, with sales roles available.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi facility is not very good, and there is no Wi-Fi facility in the institute. Classrooms are suffocating, and the library does not have books related to the courses. We can't find any useful books for our studies. There are only business magazines and English newspapers, which are of no use. I am not sure about the hostel facilities as I haven’t opted for it. Sports are conducted once a year.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Overall, college is good in terms of discipline and studies .

content.Placements: According to your question, about 65% of students get placed in my college. The average package at my college is approximately 4-5 lacs; the lowest package was 2 lacs; and the highest package currently is 27 lacs. The top recruiting companies in my college are Google, Microsoft and others.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my college is very good, all the things or facilities are available, the classrooms are clean, the benches and chairs are fine, the fans are in good condition; and there is water cooler now, if we talk about. Labs: there are many labs that are also in very good condition. So, overall infrastructure is very good .

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Our college provides average placements and the fee structure is budget-friendly.

content.Placements: Around 40% of students got placed in this course. The lowest salary package offered was 2.5 LPA. The average salary package offered was 4 LPA. The highest salary package offered was 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS, ConsultAdd, etc. Internships are not good in this course.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Our campus is spread over 35 acres of land. Laboratories and libraries are well-maintained. Hostel facilities are decent. The food served in the mess is good at reasonable prices. Medical facilities are not good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Our college is good in all aspects.

content.Placements: Our college provides many placements. Many companies visit our college and provide good salary packages. The salary packages depend on your skills. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Infosys, etc. They hire many students. You have to be aware of the field knowledge to get selection.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college has a large playground, a canteen, a campus, a bus facility, and a hostel facility. You can contact college administration from city offices for any query. Our college provides sports facilities for students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of MIT Group of Institutes.

content.Placements: Placement ratio is well-versed. Many companies visit our college to recruit students every year. The lowest salary package offered is 2 LPA, the highest salary package is 15 LPA, and the average salary package is 2.5 LPA to 4.5 LPA. Internship programs are provided to students.
content.Infrastructure: Campus is spread over a large area with separate buildings for different courses. Our campus is enabled with Wi-Fi. Canteen, library, computer labs, and sports ground are available in our college. Hostel mess food is average.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Pharmacy (B.Pharm) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Future University gives you the best placement and quality education with the power of AI.

content.Placements: I am in my second year of my Bachelor of Pharmacy course, so I didn't have knowledge about that, but my seniors have very good jobs. Overall, the experience in college was good, and teachers are motivated for placement and well-paying jobs.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my Future University is very lovely and beautiful. The labs are very advanced, and now Future University is the first AI-enabled university, so a lecture on AI and technology is added to every course. I didn't issue a hostel, so I have no information for that.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Pharmacy (B.Pharm) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I am from the 2020-2024 batch.

content.Placements: Some of us got placements through a job fair held at our college. Only 10% of students got placed that too in a job fair held by our college. No one got any internship recommendations as well. We have done internships on our own. There are no placements.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very nice. Hostel rooms are quite good and big. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned. The Wi-Fi password is not shared to us. Labs are very spacious but most of the time chemicals are short so we are not able to perform the experiments properly. Grounds are very big . In fact, the golf ground is also there. The canteen is well-maintained and one Cafe is also there. The library is good, and it has some rare books that cannot be found in the market.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor in Pharmacy (B.Pharm) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I am dissatisfied with the course as there is no placement in this course at all.

content.Placements: They are providing placements in Marketing in companies like Zone. It provides field sales jobs in the FMCG section, not even in the medical section. In 2024, only one company, Zone, came, and they also selected 6 students, but it is a sales job, and they are giving the location in Delhi, so no one has joined it. Placement for the Bachelor of Pharmacy course in the future college is the worst, and you can even say there is no placement.
content.Infrastructure: It has good infrastructure in terms of buildings, and all classrooms have AC, but no Wi-Fi on campus. I don't know about the hostel as I am a local student, so I don't live there, but my friends are from there, and they tell me the hostel is okay, but the food is not good.
